head.title: NKS AZ — Watch your episodes
head.b:skin: /* * NKS AZ — Netflix-style streaming theme v1.3.0 * Homepage: hero + "choose a series" picker + per-series episode rows, * fed live from the backend /api/catalog. * Static pages (e.g. Watch) render their own full-page UI; the theme * stays out of the way and only provides the dark background. */

div.p: Three series, one home. Choose what you are in the mood for and start watching.

div.div: Connecting to stream… (first load can take ~30–60s)

div.p: Download opens a short link first, then your download starts. Links are personal and expire — please don't share them.

footer.p: Disclaimer: All files are hosted on third-party servers. NKS AZ does not host any files on its own servers — we only index content that is already available on the internet. For any content removal request, please email us at nksaz2511@gmail.com.
